title: LiveActivationResult
description: Phase F (operator-account-onboarding): terminal outcome of LiveActivationWorkflow.activateLive / deactivateLive. The workflow returns each fail-closed refusal as a distinct outcome (NOT thrown) so api-gateway maps it to a 422 with the refusal reason; ACTIVATED/DEACTIVATED map to 200. expected_account_id (the probed brokerage account_number) is set on ACTIVATED so the operator can verify the bound account.

outcome.description: Controlled disposition. ACTIVATED: all gates passed and a fresh LivePromotionApproved row was emitted. DEACTIVATED: the LivePromotionDeactivated row was emitted and the kill switch tripped. REJECTED_NOT_LIVE: the stored strategy_config broker_target is not -live. REJECTED_CONFIG: a required live loss-gate (daily_loss_threshold>0, notional cap set) is missing. REJECTED_CAPITAL_SOURCE: capital_source is not account_cash (would over-size a small live account from the static global base). REJECTED_KILLSWITCH: the per-(tenant,strategy) kill switch is unreachable/not running (not armable). REJECTED_ACCOUNT: the fresh account probe returned a blank account_number or non-positive cash.

reason.description: Human-readable refusal detail for the REJECTED_* outcomes (e.g. the caught config-gate message). Null/omitted on ACTIVATED/DEACTIVATED.

expected_account_id.description: The probed brokerage account_number bound into the LivePromotionApproved subject (expected_account_id). Set on ACTIVATED; null/omitted otherwise. Phase F only WRITES it into the promotion row — order-time account-binding ENFORCEMENT is Phase E's concern.
